subject: Request: KMS operational narrative + rotation snapshots for CAIQ review
messages:
From: audits@orbitalpay.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2023 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ follow-up: key lineage and rotation artifacts

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. As part of our CAIQ/SIG review the audit team has asked for: a short operational narrative describing how Redwood manages KMS/HSM-backed keys (at-rest and in-transit), a sample rotation snapshot showing last 6 rotations for a tenant KMS key, and any short-form attestation from your HSM vendor about sealed key custody.

Can you provide an annotated narrative (one-pager) that explains operator roles, rotation windows, wrap/unwrap flow, and how you present rotation evidence to customers? A CSV snapshot with rotation timestamps and operator ids is fine for the rotation sample.

We'd like these artifacts attached to the CAIQ response by EOD 2023-10-06. If anything requires an NDA or redaction, please flag it.

Best,
Aditi Shah
OrbitalPay - Compliance

--
Aditi Shah
audits@orbitalpay.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: audits@orbitalpay.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2023 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: key lineage and rotation artifacts

Aditi,

Thanks — we can do that. Quick plan:

- Attached: redwood_kms_operational_narrative_v1.pdf (annotated one-page narrative describing KMS/HSM custody, at-rest vs transit keys, TLS key-handshake, and wrap/unwrap flow).
- Attached: rotation_snapshot_20231001.csv (sample, redacted operator ids) showing last 6 rotation events for a tenant KEK.
- Attached: hsm_attestation_short.txt (vendor-provided short attestation about HSM sealing and operator separation of duties).

A few notes for clarity so the CAIQ mapping is straightforward:
- We separate tenant data encryption keys (DEKs) from key-encryption-keys (KEKs). DEKs are generated per-tenant and wrapped with a KEK held in an HSM-backed key ring.
- Rotation cadence: default automatic rotation window is 90 days for KEKs; customers can request more frequent rotations. Rotations are performed via an automated ceremony in our orchestration layer; the new KEK is generated inside an HSM (no key leaves the HSM unwrapped) and a wrapping record is persisted in the audit store.
- Operator controls: operator roles that trigger rotations or initiate key-recovery are restricted by RBAC; dual-approval is required for manual emergency rotations.
- Transport: all key transfer between services uses mTLS, and payloads containing wrapped DEKs are only ever stored encrypted at rest.

I'm cc'ing Marissa (security) and Ben (infra) to confirm the snapshot redaction and add any vendor text we should include.

Jonas
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, audits@orbitalpay.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Oct 2023 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: key lineage and rotation artifacts

Hi Aditi / team,

Attached is the operational narrative Jonas mentioned plus the rotation snapshot CSV. A couple of callouts on the CSV:
- Operator ids have been redacted to hashed handles (operator_***). Full operator audit trails are available under NDA; the CSV contains timestamp, rotation_type (auto/manual/emergency), previous_key_id, new_key_id, and notes.
- We include a mapping column for the key wrapping algorithm (AES-GCM-SIV here), the HSM slot id, and whether the rotation included a re-wrap of active DEKs.

Also included the short HSM attestation we get from our cloud HSM partner confirming FIPS mode, sealed key material, and tamper-evident hardware lifecycle checks. If you need the full vendor attestation package (PDF with serials), tell us and we will coordinate with procurement — that package is typically shared under an MSA amendment.

Quick snippet of the operational checks we recommend you highlight in the CAIQ:
- Rotation proof = rotation_snapshot CSV + audit-log export for the same window.
- Key lineage = last wrap/unwrap events + operator approvals (redacted).
- Emergency rotation = dual-approval record + rollback plan (we capture these as an event in our ticketing system and can export a JSON if needed).

Let us know if the CAIQ team wants samples organized per CAIQ control id and we can remap the one-pager accordingly.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Manager, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rotation_snapshot_20231001.csv, redwood_kms_operational_narrative_v1.pdf, hsm_attestation_short.txt
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, audits@orbitalpay.com
Date: Thu, 5 Oct 2023 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: key lineage and rotation artifacts

Aditi — adding a tiny operational extract you can include in CAIQ responses under Encryption and Key Management:

- Key generation: KEKs are generated with 4096-bit RSA-wrap (or AES-256 in HSM when ECC isn't used) inside the HSM in a non-exportable key slot.
- Rotation snapshot example row: "2023-09-01T03:14:22Z,auto,key-87a, key-9f2, AES-GCM-SIV, hsm-slot-7, rewrap:true"
- Backup/escrow: encrypted backups of KEKs are stored encrypted with customer-scoped escrow keys; escrow access requires multi-party approval.

If you need a direct sample of the audit log format for a rotation event (we emit structured logs with event_id, actor, action, target_key, previous_fingerprint, new_fingerprint, ticket_ref) I can paste a sanitized example.

Ben
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: audits@orbitalpay.com <audits@orbitalpay.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Oct 2023 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ follow-up: key lineage and rotation artifacts

Hi Jonas / Marissa / Ben,

Received the attachments — thanks, these are helpful and map cleanly to the CAIQ controls. Two small asks before we close the loop:

1) Can you add a single-line clarifier to the narrative that the default KEK rotation is transparent to tenants (no re-encryption of stored blobs unless requested)?
2) For the rotation_snapshot CSV, can you replace the operator_*** hashes with role-level tags (e.g., security_admin, infra_ops) instead of per-operator hashes? That avoids an NDA but still shows separation of duties.

If you can send those two small edits by EOD Monday (10/09) we'll mark the CAIQ item as satisfied.

Regards,
Aditi Shah
OrbitalPay - Compliance
